runsheet.short_description: Transform the Poster Hall into the LBD setup.
runsheet.more_info: Set up 6-9 TVs against some walls, spaced out for audio. Stash the remaining TVs nearby reasonably. All other electronics (audio interfaces, mics, cables...) should be moved to Carlos's office or lab via cart. Move 13 Poster Boards towards the center of the space, supporting posters on both sides.
